description: Defines the HttpResponseHeaders class for parsing and managing HTTP response headers, including methods for header manipulation, validation, and retrieval of header values.

classes.name: HttpResponseHeaders
classes.description: A class that parses and holds HTTP response headers, providing methods for header manipulation, validation, and extraction of header values.

methods.name: TryToCreate
methods.description: Creates an HttpResponseHeaders object from a raw header string, returning nullptr on failure.

methods.name: Update
methods.description: Merges new headers into the existing headers following RFC 2616 rules.

methods.name: RemoveHeader
methods.description: Removes all instances of a header with the specified name.

methods.name: AddHeader
methods.description: Adds a header line with the specified name and value.

methods.name: SetHeader
methods.description: Sets a header, replacing existing headers with the same name.

methods.name: GetNormalizedHeader
methods.description: Retrieves the combined value of a header, with multiple values joined by commas.

methods.name: GetStatusLine
methods.description: Returns the normalized status line of the response.

methods.name: GetHttpVersion
methods.description: Returns the HTTP version from the status line.

methods.name: GetStatusText
methods.description: Returns the status text from the status line.

methods.name: EnumerateHeaderLines
methods.description: Iterates over header lines, skipping the status line.

methods.name: EnumerateHeader
methods.description: Iterates over values of a specific header.

methods.name: HasHeaderValue
methods.description: Checks if a header with a specific value exists.

methods.name: HasHeader
methods.description: Checks if a header with the specified name exists.

methods.name: GetMimeTypeAndCharset
methods.description: Retrieves mime type and charset from headers.

methods.name: GetMimeType
methods.description: Retrieves mime type in lowercase.

methods.name: GetCharset
methods.description: Retrieves charset in lowercase.

methods.name: IsRedirect
methods.description: Determines if the response is a redirect and optionally returns the location.

methods.name: RequiresValidation
methods.description: Determines if the response requires validation based on headers and timing.

methods.name: GetFreshnessLifetimes
methods.description: Calculates how long the response is considered fresh.

methods.name: GetCurrentAge
methods.description: Calculates the current age of the response.

methods.name: GetContentLength
methods.description: Returns the content length from headers.

methods.name: GetContentRangeFor206
methods.description: Parses Content-Range header for 206 responses.

methods.name: IsChunkEncoded
methods.description: Checks if the response is chunk-encoded.

methods.name: NetLogParams
methods.description: Creates a log representation of the headers.
